outcome: Changes in HBV viral load during pregnancy
Infant completion of HBV vaccination series
cohort: 132 mothers positive for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and their 135 infants in Vancouver, British Columbia.
finding: HBV viral load remained stable throughout pregnancy, and while no perinatal transmissions were observed, a significant proportion of infants did not complete the recommended HBV vaccination and follow-up schedule.
